title: LatentWeave: Test-Time Latent Optimization for Multimodal Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.39557v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent advances in test-time optimization have shown that the multimodal reasoning performance of large multimodal language models (MLLMs) can be improved during inference without modifying backbone model parameters. However, existing approaches primarily operate at the prompt or output level, leaving the latent reasoning process largely uncontrolled and insufficient to prevent error accumulation during autoregressive generation. To address this limitation, we propose LatentWeave, a test-time framework that treats multimodal reasoning as a controllable latent trajectory. LatentWeave performs structured Latent Weaving, progressively refining intermediate hidden states segment-wise to correct emerging deviations, and further introduces Reasoning Anchors via lightweight WEAVE tokens to stabilize reasoning structure and guide answer-oriented generation. translated_title: LatentWeave：面向多模态推理的测试时潜空间优化
translated_abstract: 测试时优化的最新进展表明，大型多模态语言模型（MLLM）的多模态推理性能可以在推理过程中得到提升，而无需修改骨干模型参数。然而，现有方法主要在提示或输出层面进行操作，使得潜在推理过程在很大程度上不受控制，不足以防止自回归生成过程中的误差累积。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了LatentWeave，这是一个将多模态推理视为可控潜在轨迹的测试时框架。LatentWeave执行结构化的潜空间编织，逐段渐进地精炼中间隐藏状态以纠正新出现的偏差，并通过轻量级的WEAVE令牌进一步引入推理锚点，以稳定推理结构并引导面向答案的生成。这些机制旨在实现对推理过程的细粒度、步骤感知的干预。
tldr: 提出LatentWeave测试时框架，将多模态推理建模为可控潜在轨迹，通过逐段精炼隐藏状态的潜空间编织和基于轻量级WEAVE令牌的推理锚点，在不修改模型参数的情况下实现对推理过程的细粒度、步骤感知干预，从而减少自回归生成中的误差累积。
en_tdlr: LatentWeave is a test-time framework that treats multimodal reasoning as a controllable latent trajectory, using structured latent weaving to progressively refine hidden states and lightweight WEAVE tokens as reasoning anchors, enabling fine-grained, step-aware intervention without modifying backbone model parameters to prevent error accumulation.
